premises.text: Cloud data centers are energy-intensive and face rising demand and cost pressure
premises.evidence_span: massive energy-guzzling data centers that are often designed to maximize profits without much regard for the environment

premises.text: Billions of idle consumer devices represent unused compute capacity
premises.evidence_span: 12 billion devices sit idly in our pockets or on our desks

premises.text: Distributed software can harness everyday devices for intensive compute workloads
premises.evidence_span: harnesses the collective strength of everyday devices to tackle intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI and 3D rendering

premises.text: Revenue sharing can incentivize device owners to join the network
premises.evidence_span: We share 70% of the revenue and we allow you to earn up to $150 per month for each device that you provide

premises.text: Distributed compute can be faster and cheaper than traditional cloud for customers
premises.evidence_span: accelerate their workflows up to 30 times relative to the cloud

premises.text: Reusing idle devices reduces energy waste versus data centers
premises.evidence_span: reducing substantial energy wastage relative to traditional data centers

value.text: Computing becomes sustainable and equitable through a distributed device grid

notes: Beta status, waitlist, and Storj partnership excluded as traction.
